summary: Banani Dental Clinic - first iteration testing. Backend (Node.js Express + MongoDB) and frontend (React) both pass with high confidence. 30/30 backend pytest cases passed including real Cloudinary uploads and destroys. Frontend e2e flows verified: home, gallery filters/lightbox/before-after, appointment form submission, admin login (good+bad creds), dashboard stats, doctors list, gallery upload->Cloudinary->grid->delete, appointments listing + status update, mobile responsive sidebar, logout and protected route redirect.

issues: Console: 1 spurious 401 GET /api/auth/me on public pages when no token is present (AuthContext probably runs verify on mount even on public site). Not user-visible but generates noise; could be conditional on token presence.

action_items: Optional: skip GET /api/auth/me call in AuthContext when no token in localStorage to avoid 401 noise on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js handles _id correctly (mapped to id in route handlers, _id removed) - good.
JWT secret read from env; bcrypt password compare correct.
Cloudinary destroyAsset is called on doctor PUT when photo replaced and on DELETE for both doctors and gallery - correct cleanup.
before-after gallery items intentionally seeded with non-Cloudinary URLs and 'seed/' publicIds; documented as acceptable.
Files reasonably sized; no >700 line offenders. data-testid coverage is good across pages.
seed_data_creation: Seeded by backend on startup (idempotent): 1 admin, 2 doctors, 7 gallery items (1 before-after). Tests prefix all created data with TEST_ and clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is Node.js Express, not FastAPI. Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns {token,user}. JWT stored in localStorage as 'bdc_admin_token'. Real Cloudinary credentials are in backend/.env (cloud_name=dadqlgwdr) - uploads create real assets but tests delete them. Bengali UI labels are used throughout (admin nav uses Bengali in label, so prefer URL navigation in Playwright over `admin-nav-{label}` selectors with non-ASCII content). Contact form testIds: appt-name, appt-phone, appt-email, appt-date, appt-service, appt-message, appointment-submit, appointment-success, appointment-error.
